ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure contains four small maps, labeled A, B, C, and D respectively. Map B is the second one; the upper part of the small map is marked with a meridian of about 20°, the northern part is close to the 66.5°N latitude line, the island outline is similar to Iceland, and the black triangle symbols in the figure indicate volcano locations. Then reason: The stem states that the destinations are volcanoes on peninsulas or islands, so location B can be identified as a volcano tourism site in Iceland. Iceland’s coasts are affected by glacial erosion and seawater intrusion, and many fjord landscapes are formed, so charming fjord scenery can also be enjoyed near location B.
